description: Engine §10: ending-after filters whole, prefix, suffix and part forests and their tags.
grammar:
%rule text A B
%conditions $.parse(A B).ending-after($.first-token), $.parse(A …).ending-after($.preceding-tokens), $.parse(… B).ending-after($.first-token), $.parse(… B …).ending-after($.first-token), Long ⊆ $.parse(r …).ending-after($.first-token).tags, Short ⊈ $.parse(r …).ending-after($.first-token).tags
%rule r
 | A :: Short
 | A B :: Long
